start.title: By the Sea
start.text:
Jesus sits by the lake.
"Listen. A sower went out to sow."

choices.feedback: Stay. The seed is for you.

drift_consequence.title: Return to Him
drift_consequence.text:
A wandering heart hears nothing.
Come back to the words.

sower.title: The Sower
sower.text:
A farmer walks the field,
scattering seed with open hand.

dull_consequence.title: Look Again
dull_consequence.text:
Heaven hides in small things.
Watch the seed once more.

path.title: On the Path
path.text:
Some seed falls on the hard path.
Birds swoop down and take it away.

choices.text: Ask why your heart is hard
Shrug, it is only a seed
choices.feedback: Each seed is a whole word.

blame_consequence.title: Not His Fault
blame_consequence.text:
He gives the same seed to all.
The ground decides.

choices.text: Ask why your heart is hard

shrug_consequence.title: Each Word Matters
shrug_consequence.text:
One word can change a life.
Do not let it be stolen.

choices.text: Ask why your heart is hard

rocky.title: On the Rocks
rocky.text:
Some seed springs up quickly,
but the sun burns its shallow roots.

choices.text: Trust only when life is easy
Pray for roots that go deep

easy_consequence.title: Roots Grow Down
easy_consequence.text:
Joy that fears the sun is shallow.
Ask for what lasts.

choices.text: Pray for roots that go deep

thorns.title: Among Thorns
thorns.text:
Other seed grows beside thorns.
Worry and riches choke it out.

choices.text: Let the thorns go from your heart

worry_consequence.title: Lay It Down
worry_consequence.text:
Worry is a weed in the soul.
Give it to the One who sows.

choices.text: Let the thorns go from your heart

wealth_consequence.title: Open Your Hand
wealth_consequence.text:
A closed fist holds no seed.
Let the soil breathe.

choices.text: Let the thorns go from your heart

good_soil.title: On Good Soil
good_soil.text:
Other seed falls on willing ground
and bears thirty, sixty, a hundredfold.

choices.text: Receive the word and grow with it

selfish_consequence.title: Share the Grain
selfish_consequence.text:
Good soil never keeps its bread.
It feeds the hungry world.

choices.text: Receive the word and grow with it

disciples.title: What Does It Mean?
disciples.text:
The disciples come close and ask,
"Teacher, tell us the meaning."

choices.feedback: Stay. You do not know yet.

sure_consequence.title: Stay and Learn
sure_consequence.text:
Pride is the hardest path.
Kneel with the rest.

ending.title: What Soil Are You?
ending.text:
Jesus looks at you and smiles.
"The seed is the word. You are the ground."
